verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Files On-Demand/online-only files and offline pinning ('Always keep on this device'), which cover selective sync and on-demand file behavior, but concrete hands-on reports describe sync corrupting or destroying file contents, reverting files to old versions with no recovery, and forced/unexpected backup behavior that breaks the 'just works' experience (onedrive-comm-5, onedrive-comm-13, onedrive-comm-16). Missing for 10: explicit macOS client parity documentation, first-party evidence addressing the reported corruption/version-loss issues, and independent verification that selective sync is reliable across both platforms.
